# v2.4 Release Notes

## New

- **Dark mode.** Switch to a dark color theme across the app.
- **CSV import.** Bring spreadsheet data into your workspace by importing CSV files.

## Fixed

- **Crash when renaming a folder.** Renaming a folder no longer crashes the app.
- **Slow search on large workspaces.** Search is faster in workspaces with many items.

# v2.4 Release Notes

## New

- **Dark mode.** Switch to a dark color theme across the app.
- **CSV import.** Bring spreadsheet data into your workspace by importing CSV files.

## Fixed

- **Crash when renaming a folder.** Renaming a folder no longer crashes the app.
- **Slow search on large workspaces.** Search is faster in workspaces with many items.
